description: This Java source file defines the ContentImageController class which manages static content images in a web application. It includes methods for viewing, adding, and removing content images, handling HTTP requests related to image management, and interacts with the ContentService for content operations.

classes.name: ContentImageController
classes.description: Controller class managing static content images including display, upload, and delete functionalities.

methods.name: displayFileBrowser
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the file browser for content images.

methods.name: getContentImages
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch and display content images for a merchant store.

methods.name: pageImages
methods.description: Handles POST requests to return paginated image data as a JSON response.

methods.name: displayContentImagesCreate
methods.description: Displays the page for adding new content images.

methods.name: saveContentImages
methods.description: Processes form submissions to save uploaded content images to the system.

methods.name: removeImage
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a specified image from the system.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Private helper method to set the menu context for the web interface.
